issue_context.summary: A mixed-resolution, mixed-DPI three-monitor setup cannot produce the desired cross-monitor zones: a spanning layout is mis-scaled, while separate per-monitor layouts cannot be selected as one cross-monitor group.
known_information: The setup uses two 4K portrait monitors at 150% and one 2K landscape monitor at 100%.
The editor preview and applied spanning layout disagree on zone size and position.
The report also requests a new cross-monitor snapping capability for separate layouts.
inferences: The thread combines a DPI coordinate bug in span-across-monitors mode with an enhancement request to combine zones from independent work areas.
issue_context.analysis: These outcomes require different designs. A current topology plus active FancyZones setting and applied layout screenshot is necessary to isolate the scaling bug from the unsupported separate-layout interaction.
initial_investigation: Issue 30706 is documentation saying FancyZones can work with different DPI, but it does not cover spanning-coordinate correctness.
Current FancyZones has distinct spanZonesAcrossMonitors and per-monitor work-area branches.

comment.body:
Thanks for describing the two 4K portrait displays at 150% and the 2K landscape display at 100%. The report currently combines a mis-scaled spanning layout with a separate enhancement request to combine zones from independent monitor layouts.

**Needed**
1. Please list each display's current pixel resolution, scaling, orientation, primary status, and left-to-right virtual position, and attach a Windows Display Settings screenshot with sensitive content hidden.
2. Please confirm whether **Allow zones to span across monitors** is enabled and attach the editor preview and applied-zone overlay for that same configuration.

This will isolate a DPI coordinate defect from the unsupported cross-work-area selection request.

proposed_fixes.title: Use one coordinate space for mixed-DPI spanning layouts
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Best current hypothesis: editor zones are serialized in device-independent or combined-monitor coordinates and the runtime reapplies per-monitor DPI conversion, shifting or resizing zones across the mixed-DPI boundary.
plan: Record editor, serialized, and runtime rectangles with explicit coordinate-space/DPI metadata.
Normalize the spanning work area and every zone in one physical-pixel coordinate space at the process boundary.
Add mixed orientation/scaling tests; treat cross-selection from separate layouts as a separately approved enhancement.
verification: Apply the same spanning layout across 150% portrait and 100% landscape displays and verify preview and runtime rectangles match.

confidence.rationale: Mixed-DPI conversion is plausible, but the current setting and coordinate map are missing and the report includes a separate enhancement.
